objective: Create a Governed Agent Tool Registry with Capability-Based Permissions (#1146)
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Deliver documented architecture (ADR), data-flow diagram, threat model, failure modes, and operational ownership
AC-2: Implement core domain model (tool schemas, scopes, risk tiers, approval requirements) and versioned contracts with boundary validation
AC-3: Implement short-lived scoped capability tokens with HMAC signing, replay protection, cross-user binding, and admin revocation
AC-4: Integrate server-side enforcement into api/[...path].js via api/_lib/handlers/agent-tool-registry.js with Clerk RBAC and PII-scrubbed audit logging
AC-5: Deliver end-to-end vertical slice in Assistant.jsx and Admin.jsx with accessible controls and human-approval gating
AC-6: Add unit, integration, concurrency, retry, and adversarial security tests using synthetic fixtures only, plus reproducible evaluation report
AC-7: Pass tests, lint, lint:security, contracts:check, and production build with zero merge conflicts
non_goals: Do not claim official government integration, verification, legal authority, or guaranteed outcomes
Do not expose real citizen records, credentials, or private documents in logs, prompts, or analytics
No autonomous filing, benefit denial, or official-status claims
